articleTitle: Water Resources Management in Iraq
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: Summary form only given, as follows. The complete presentation was not made available for publication as part of the conference proceedings. The Middle East is considered as an arid to semi-arid area where the average annual rainfall does not exceed 155mm/year. Iraq is located in the northeastern part of the Middle East. The water of Tigris and Euphrates Rivers and their tributaries are the main water resource for Iraq. The long-term average of flow of the Tigris was about 22.2 BCM and 24.78BCM from its tributaries while it is 30 BCM from the Euphrates River. The flow started to decrease from all these rivers due to climate change and the constriction of hydrological projects in riparian countries. It is believed that rainfall and the flow of these rivers will continue to decrease in future. To overcome this problem Iraq should take fast steps on regional and national levels. Iraq should reach a serious agreement with riparian countries about its share of water from these rivers. On national level, new long-term strategy is required that should take care of: Rehabilitating of dams, barrages & pump stations, Improving the efficiency of diversion and supply, Using of Nonconventional Water Resources, Irrigation modernization using suitable techniques, developing a Public awareness program and establishing an agenda for training.

publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: Summary form only given, as follows. The complete presentation was not made available for publication as part of the conference proceedings. articleTitle: V/F Control of Three Phase Induction Motor Driven by VSI Based on SVPWM
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: This work presents a simple and efficient method for the open and closed-loop for controlling a three-phase induction motor driven by a three-phase voltage source inverter VSI. The space vector pulse width modulation SVPWM is used as a controller for VSI. A three-phase supply with variable amplitude and variable frequency is used to control the starting current and the speed of the three-phase induction motor. Proportional and integral controller (PI) is used in the feedback closed-loop control and its gain values are calculated using Simulink tuner. A complete Simulink model is built to show the response of the motor when subjected to external rated torque. Simulation results showed the system faced external torque values applied and give the desired response when tested.

articleTitle: A Low-Cost Real-Time Monitoring System for the River Level in Wasit Province
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: The Tigris and Euphrates rivers, as well as their branches, are the lifeblood of Iraq, with most of the country’s cities and villages constructed along their banks. Water in rivers is used for drinking, watering and other purposes. However, the height of the water in the rivers is continually changing. This alteration of altitude in the water is affecting the nearby environment. Thus, controlling the water level after the dams and the ratio of water among Iraqi cities has been a challenging problem for the government departments that are concerned with this aspect. They depend on manual and traditional methods to check the altitude of water once every day. In this paper, we present a real time monitoring system for measuring the water levels of the river. A microprocessor and an ultrasonic sensor are the main components of the system, which track the water level in real-time and relay data via GPRS technology. Based on the test results, this system has an accuracy rate of 96.84%.

articleTitle: Confinement of RC Columns by Carbon Fiber Reinforced Geopolymer Adhesive Jackets
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: The strengthening and rehabilitation of reinforced concrete structures is an important issue all over the world. Fiber reinforced composites are mainly used for the strengthen and rehabilitation of concrete members. However, its use is limited due to its high price and environmental effects and its adoption of epoxy as an adhesive, where epoxy is considered inefficient at high temperatures and loses most of its properties. The solution to this problem leads to the use of low-cost locally available geopolymer adhesive paste. This paper presents the experimental results of testing four reinforced concrete columns confined by carbon fiber reinforced geopolymer adhesive. Variable included, number of jacket layer (one layer, two layers and three layers). The results were it was found that the confinement by carbon fiber reinforced geopolymer adhesive improved the load enhancement ratio and deformation capacity by (333% and 411%), respectively compared with unconfined RC column.

articleTitle: Healthy Recovery Based Architectural-Environmental Design: Physical Therapy Spaces as a Case Study
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: Physiotherapy is a medical profession offered to individuals in order to regain Movement to the maximum, develop and maintain functional capabilities at all stages of a person’s life, Physiotherapy involves the combination of both physical and psychological well-being factors Many studies was done around supporting well-being interior design These studies dealt with an individual aspect of Wellbeing and do not link its various aspects,so The study came to address the problem of the lack of comprehensiveness application aspects of physical and psychological Well-being in physical therapy spaces interior design,Where traditional rehabilitation facilities do not provide patients with suitable environments for physical or mental Recovery, by isolating them in closed static spaces, The results of the research provide a good understanding of the factors, communication with nature and the dynamic spaces in the interior Design of physical therapy spaces, and provide a scientific reference for the operators and designers of these facilities as well as researchers interested in this field.

articleTitle: Implementation of Steganography in Speech Signal Using Spread Spectrum Modulation and Differential Method in Wireless Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: In this paper, two steganography techniques to improve speech quality and clarity in communication systems and bandwidth expansion factor of the signal are designed and evaluated through simulation study. The two methods are: direct sequence modulation and differential methods. In order to achieve the desired speech quality, the speech signal parameters such as speech power ratio and the number of segments in a message were changed. Direct sequence modulation was performed by multiplying the source signal into a pseudo-random sequence. The resolution of the image depends on the size of the segment and the signal strength ratio. The second method is using differential methods. Similar to the first method, speech signal is divided into specified number of segments and for each one, one bit of message is embedded. Comparative and experimental studies are performed to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed methods, where peak signal to noise ratio(PSNR) is used to assess the speech quality. Results of the study suggested that in the direct sequence method, the higher the speech power ratio, the clearer the hidden image in the signal. The result is better speech quality in communication system receivers. In the differential method, the higher number of segments results in a higher PSNR value. The proposed method are implemented and simulated in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Impact of Dilation Angle and Viscosity on the Ultra-High Performance Concrete Behavior in Abaqus
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: Abaqus CAE is one of the structural analysis software using the finite element method. This program is used to analyze the conventional concrete and high-strength concrete members. Ultra high-performance concrete (UHPC) is characterized by its high compressive strength and relatively high tensile strength, as well as ductile behavior upon failure compared to conventional concrete. The numerical analysis of beams depends on the material modeling, which, in turn, relies on some parameters. Among these parameters available in the concrete damage plasticity (CDP) model in Abaqus are the dilation angle and the viscosity parameters. This paper deals numerically with the influence of these two parameters used in defining the CDP model of UHPC T-beams under four-point loading. The findings show that the CDP model can simulate the UHPC behavior under loading. The viscosity and dilation angle have a significant role in determining the beam’s capacity in the analysis. Raising the viscosity parameter increases the beam’s capacity for loading and deflection when the dilation angle is constant. Similarly, expanding the dilation angle increases the beam’s capability slightly when the viscosity is kept constant.

articleTitle: Prediction of Axial Capacity of Hexagonal Concrete-Filled Steel Tube Columns
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: The present study aims to introduce a new method that gives accurate predictions of the ultimate capacity of hexagonal concrete-filled steel tube columns. Experimental data available in the literature were used to validate the new method. Also, it was used to construct a constitutive model for the core concrete that can be employed in the finite element analysis. This allows testing the model with the available experimental results of the behavior of hexagonal columns under concentric load. An extensive parametric study was carried out to explore the effects of different parameters on the behavior and ultimate capacity of the columns. The effects of the compressive concrete strength, yield strength of steel ratio and depth-to-thickness of the tube ratio were investigated. It is found that these parameters have significant effects on the behavior of the columns, for example a reduction in depth-to-thickness ratio from 33 to 17 gave a 100% increase in ultimate strength.

articleTitle: Extraction of The Neural Edge and its Properties for The Retina Infected with Glaucoma
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: Glaucoma is a prevalent disease of the retina. The primary objective of the current study is to improve the expectation system to ensure that a person might get a Glaucoma and using the effective algorithms to skillfully identify the parts which will be influenced. To recognize and isolate the optic disc, optic cup and neuro-retinal rim, the method is invented in the current study which in return helps in the recognition of the change in the cup size and comparing it with the disc cup. The algorithm employed two steps to individualize the optic disc from the anatomical structure of the retina image and the major step depends on the severity threshold. It is the function of the schematic technique to notice the previous disorders, their size and locations depending on following steps which are: subtracting the region of the optic cup from that of the optic disc, dividing the resulted regions into four quadrants, comparing them according to ISNT and calculating the rim to disc ration where the four modern catcher algorithms are figured. Consequently, the researcher aims for the early discovering of the neural edge of the retina and its characteristics. This mechanism is used in more than 650 images of the retinal fundus of the ORIGA dataset is an important method for documenting retinal health. It has been worked on MATLAB 2020B where it accuracy reached to 98%.

articleTitle: Practical Work for a Stand-alone Photovoltaic System: Efficient MPPT using Neural Network Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: Clean energy is the future of energy in most countries because it is cheap and does not need fossil fuels. In this study, we will present a practical experience of the solar panel system that works according to artificial intelligence techniques (ANN) and to reach the maximum power tracking point. The suggested model can boost the steady-state efficiency and the dynamic performance of the scheme. It also establishes an accurate design of the optimal or maximum operating point and an accurate estimation of the maximum power from the photovoltaic panel. At first, we work on the mechanical side to reach the best connection from the solar radiation and then work on the booster control to reach the best performance of the system and more stability and predict the possibilities of different weather conditions. We chose an ANN algorithm for this experiment where we will collect data from different weather conditions through light and temperature sensors and then train the algorithm (ANN) on this data in order to be able to predict any possible weather condition and choose the best energy point in any condition and finally implement the algorithm and follow its work and reach the smart standalone tablet system.

articleTitle: Derive Shear Design Formula for Aerated Reinforced Concrete Piles Cap
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: This paper is focused on the numerical study to investigate the behavior of pile caps and evaluate their shear capacity when lightweight foam reinforced concrete is used in their construction. The lightweight foam reinforced concrete made by aluminum powder. The work includes modeling twelve reinforced concrete pile caps supported by two, three and four piles. The numerical investigation includes using Finite Element Method in (FEM) numerical software program, using different analytical solution methods (ACI, EC2, CSA and NZS) and extracted an equation to calculate shear strength depending on numerical results. In the Finite Element analysis three different models (A1, A2 and A3) were taken numerical in terms of dimensions, the number of piles, and the steel reinforcement, meaning that the difference is total in terms of geometry. The models were dealt with in the basis that it was deep beam and slab. The reason for this is due to the nature of failure in the shear. The shear failure for deep beam and punching shear for slab. The analytical investigation was conducted to predict ultimate shear strength of these pile caps using some existing empirical equations and formulas proposed in the present research. Where the results were extracted from these formulas and compared with the results that concluded from the FEM. The results from international design methods and extracted equation showed varying ratios for shear strength between slabs and deep beam.

articleTitle: Estimation of Predictive Potential of Quasi-Biennoal Oscillation (QBO) Cyclical Stratospheric Circulation in Tropical Zone for Long-Term Precipitation Forecast
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: for our knowledge, this represented the first Iraqi report that aimed for assessment if the worldwide signals can employ as predictor variables among long-range forecast. Hence, a simple relationship assay with QBO was applied for examining long-term precipitation over many Iraqi main cities with variable phases of QBO throughout stratospheric zonal, the Eastern and Western, winds. As well as, this study was carried out for exploring, predictably, long season of precipitation by the data concerned to QBO phases during 1951-2010; and for statistical studying of spatially relationship pattern for understanding climatic correlation of equatorially stratospheric zonal winds with the regionally precipitation during the scale of inter-annual time. Statistically, the findings showed that the highest significance (P<0.0001) precipitation rate during wet season reported in January, while the lowest in October; and the average value of precipitation rate depended relatively on passage of air masses. In summer, values of standard deviation for Western wind passes Iraq were minimal; whereas in winter, values being maximum. Regarding Eastern phase of QBO Cycle in stratospheric circulation, statistical analysis showed that there no significant differences (P≤0.0717) within the values of Aa and Bb. However, significant differences (P≤0.0364) were detected when the values of Aa compared with the values of Bb. For Western phase of QBO Cycle in stratospheric circulation, the findings revealed no significant variation (P≤0.0523) within the values of Aa and Bb; while, significant variation (P≤0.009) was seen between the values of Aa and Bb. Concerning Aa repeatability of the Eastern and Western phases, no significant differences (P≤0.712) were detected within values of both phases; but not between them (P<0.0001). For Bb repeatability, significant variation within (P≤0.0202) and between (P≤0.0003) values of both phases was detected.

articleTitle: Bus Stop Points for Urban Passenger Transport and the Factors That Influence Their Capacity
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: The types of urban passenger transport are of the greatest importance for the life of the city, the role of which is a modern city is reduced to providing convenience and reducing the time spent on travel. The capacity of the bus stop point is an important part of the public transports system where the efficiency of the public buses depends on the high workability and the level of service at these points. The aim of this study is to form a group of public transports for urban passenger transport and factors influencing the capacity of bus stop points; in this study, the data was collected from different stop points in Chelyabinsk city, Russia. According to the Highway Capacity Manuals (HCM 2000), the capacity of buses, stops are calculated. The main principles of study were the dependencies of the number of passengers and types of public transport on the time of day for two directions of the movement. Varies from time of day with a frequency of about four hours, however, with a shift in the maximum passenger demand at stopping points because of the commercial and industrial establishments contained in the study site

articleTitle: Effect of Rainfall Intensity on Channel Sediment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: Soil erosion is one of the most influential problems of land degradation worldwide. Soil erosion has many forms, such as splash erosion, inter-rill erosion, rill erosion and gully erosion. Rills caused by runoff over erodible soil are usually irregular in profile and cross section and may not approximate any regular geometrical shape. Therefore, the flow hydraulics in rills may differ greatly from the hydraulics of large channel flow. In this study, the experimental rainfall simulations were conducted to investigate the change of channel sediment discharge by rainfall intensity due to the formation of inter-rills, rills, gullies, and streams. Four rainfall events conducted with two rainfall intensities (2.33 and 2.67 mm.min<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>), each rainfall intensity is applied with two model cases (first is natural soil, and the second contains 50% natural soil+ 50% sand), with land slope 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</sup>, rainfall duration was 90 min, and the flow velocity of the channel is 0.1 m.s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>. The results show that the cumulative sediment amount increases with the an increase of rainfall intensity, the channel sediment increase with the initiation of rills.

articleTitle: Study The Effect of Storage Capacity on The Performance of Swimming Pool Heating System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: The current study includes a theoretical investigation of the influence of different mass storage (Ms) or the effect of storage capacity on the solar fraction factor (f) of a proposed solar heating system which can be used for heating "Al-Saab Olympic Indoor Swimming Pool" located in Baghdad (Iraq) at a latitude of 33.32°N. A computer program was built using the MATLAB environment to solve the mathematical model equations to calculate the solar fraction factor (f) of the proposed solar heating system at different solar collecting areas, at two different types of the solar collector which are (type A: two covers selective absorber solar collector, and type B: pool absorber (PVC) solar collector), and at four different values of (Ms) which are (25, 50, 75, and 100 Kg/m2collecting area). The results showed that the highest values of solar fraction factor were obtained when using the solar collector type A. It has been observed, that the effect of changing Ms is imperceptible on the value of the solar fraction factor (f) at solar collecting area less than 5000 m2 but its effect increases at solar collecting area more than 5000 m2.

articleTitle: Diagnosing of air compressor faults using frequency data driven approach
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: Faults in rotating or reciprocating machines can be induced due to lack of maintenance or pre-existed defect of the components during the manufacturing. These faults can cause dangerous consequences and great cost losing or even cause fatal incidents. Thus, detection of these faults in a suitable time will no doubt provide the opportunity for the decision-makers to determine the suitable intervention and to avoid the possible break down. In the present research, a frequency data-driven based methodology is developed to conduct the detection and identification of faults presence and type in an air compressor. This methodology has two main stages; feature extraction and classification. The features are extracted from the frequency representation of signals and each feature represents the mean value of a certain frequency band amplitude. A deterministic similarity measure is used in the classification stage. The results show that the present simple methodology can effectively detect and identify the air compressor faults.

articleTitle: Regenerative design Method and Its relation with Vernacular Architecture : Kurdish vernacular Architecture as a case study
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: Following the global pandemic crisis it is critical for our cities to implement new design solutions that will allow our cities to implement innovative design solutions, to our cities to adapt particularly during the terrible times we have been forced to face. It has been discovered that the design method that our ancestors followed in Vernacular architecture was prepared to resist all difficult circumstances by studying design methods in our vernacular architecture that have always gone through difficult times. According to the literature review, it has been brought to light that the vernacular architecture of the country's population is an indigenous regenerative architecture. This paper aims to explore the regenerative design method in Kurdish vernacular architecture creating a Theoretical framework as an attempt to organize and work with this design method. The paper concluded that Kurdish vernacular architecture uses the method of regenerative design because it is based on the principles of reuse, re-storage and revitalization as well as using all the context resources to live with the environment without wasting resources.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Different Models of Stepped Spillway With Using HALF-BALL Configuration
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: The stepped spillway is a hydraulic structure; it improves the energy dissipation of large discharge. The aim of this study is to reduce the high kinetic energy by adding several configurations on steps numerically. The configuration included addition of half-ball configuration on the outer edges of steps. Flow 3D software is used to analyze the flow over the stepped spillway model for all configuration on steps. The numerical simulations used the volume of fluid method to simulate free surface flow and Renormalized group k- ε turbulence model which is enhanced the accuracy of rapid flows. It was observed that the maximum energy dissipation occurs when the diameter of half-ball is equal to half the length of the step. This study also examined the effect of the step’s slope and height on the energy dissipation when using a half-ball arrangement on the outer edge of the steps in large discharge. The results showed that the relative energy loss increases as the slope of step decrease and step height increase, the efficiency estimated as 46%, 33% and 18% for slope 18 °, 27° and 45° respectively and 33%, 32%, 23% for step height 12cm, 9cm and 6cm. But it has no significant change on the static pressure values for different step height and slopes along the stepped spillway.in addition, Froude number increases as the slope of step increases and step height decreases

articleTitle: Design a New Smart Monitoring Micro-Grid Photovoltaic System Network Based on Mobile Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: Due to high prices of petroleum products and lack of electricity in Iraq and the absence of appropriate legislation and government incentives to use electricity generated from solar cells. In the past five years, the Middle Technical University has focused on the use of electrical energy generated by solar cells as a result of the Middle East's favourable environment for using this energy. Within the manuscript, a new project of communication and control scheme for the micro-grid photovoltaic systems installed at one of the university's technological institutes (Technical Institute-Kut) was done to simplify the process of controlling the solar system. This system proposed to monitor the status (current and voltage) of all photovoltaic inverters were connected to the grid of Technical Institute Kut. The communications network of this micro-grid, which relies on Bluetooth device and the mobile phone as a communication protocol for data transfer between photovoltaic systems nodes, and transfer the reading of voltage and current to mobile the phone for monitoring. The main benefit of this system is to predict the faults that occur in the photovoltaic systems for repairing this system to minimize material and electrical losses in the full grid. The simplicity of this system made it more applicable with similar other systems. Also, the most powerful point of this system is the cheapest material used and very low cost overall and highly response activity.

articleTitle: Seismic Performance of Underground Water Pipelines
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: Throughout previous earthquakes, underground pipelines system undergoes big damages led to serious impacts. Therefore, the parameters that affect the behaviour of underground pipelines under seismic load have been studied. Three tests were carried out utilising a shaking table for the buried pipe model in dry case and saturated case. Cohesionless soil was utilised as a foundation and backfill for the pipe model. Gravel (filter) is used as a first layer at the base of container. UPVC pipe with a diameter of 50 mm was used. The dynamic behaviour of buried pipe is evaluated in terms of vertical displacement (settlement), acceleration response and dynamic soil pressure. Also includes the effect of the gravel with certain thickness under pipes in terms of time history of acceleration, vertical displacement, and dynamic soil pressure. The results showed the amplification occurred at the top surface of pipe model due to amplified occurred with increasing the thickness of layers. For this reason, the design of underground pipelines system requires a big care for the decision-maker. As well as attenuation occurred in seismic waves with increasing depth of layers in the saturated case. Due to liquefaction phenomenon which leads to reduced shear strength of soil as a result accumulation of excess pore water pressure.

articleTitle: Improvement The Heat dissipation By Using Different Integral Finned Tubes For Cross Flow Heat Exchanger
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: This experimental study exhibits enhancement of the heat transfer for four models of cross-flow heat exchangers (Smooth, LIF, MIF, and HIF) with eight -paths. The cold air flows on the outer surface for tubes (1, 1.7, 2.3) m /sec. The hot water streams inner tubes with (2-6) L/ min and temperature (50, 60, 70) ° C. The results explain that the fins generally enhance the heat dissipation more from the smooth surface. When comparison among the three models (LIF, MIF, HIF), HIF gives good improvement with values (329.95%, 291%, and 0.180) heat dissipation, E.F %, effectiveness respectively. Empirical correlations of (Nua) calculate at constant temperature for (Smooth, LIF, MIF, HIF)[1].

articleTitle: An Experimental Study to Improve Heat Transfer Rate in a Double Pipe Heat Exchanger Using Helical Tape
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: In this experimental study, a double pipe heat exchanger made of stainless -steel with inner and outer diameters are (11.43 and 16.83 cm) respectively, for two cases plain tube and helical tape with a central rod inserted inside the inner pipe with (1.5 m) length and pitch of (11 cm). the working fluids are air as hot fluid pass through the inner pipe. Heavy fuel oil is a cold fluid flowing through the outer pipe. The results showed that the helical tape inside the inner pipe was better than the smooth tube in the rate of heat transfer as well as the heat transfer coefficient, the overall heat transfer coefficient and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Concatenated Turbo Polar Codes: An Overview
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: Although the polar codes can achieve the Binary-Input Discrete Memoryless Channel (BI-DMLC) capacity, their performance deteriorates at the finite-code lengths, especially in small SNRs. Therefore, the Turbo Polar Codes are proposed to improve the performance of polar codes in a finite-length regime. In this paper, several turbo polar codes are presented to review the state of the art in Turbo polar codes.

articleTitle: Estimation of Flood Hazards Using Hec-Ras 1D: The Case of Al-Musandaq Escape
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: Floods have been considered amongst the most recurring and devastating natural hazard types as they result in extensive economic losses to humans and infrastructures worldwide. Maysan city in southern Iraq is prone to recurrent floods and was severely affected by the Flood 2019 in the recent past. Flood hazard estimation is an important strategy for flood control and flood hazard reduction. This study was focused on the Flood Hazard Estimation in the River Tigris from the downstream of Al-Kut Barrage to Al-Musandaq Escape of 169 km in length. by utilizing the HEC-RAS model. Sixty two cross-sections surveyed in 2017 have been utilized in this study. information related to the hydrological and topographical Digital Elevation Model data has been utilized as input data. The flood estimating data was found to be accurate when compared to past studies and research, as well as the data employed, indicating that the HEC-RAS software can be used to accurately estimate floods. To control the flood and to protect Maysan of the related risks, the study suggested designing a weir at the front of Maysan and having a specific level where no more than 700 m3/s drainages are allowed to pass, as the drainage of 700m3/s and more causes dangers to Maysan.

articleTitle: Plastic Hinge Zone Effect on Seismic Evaluation of RC Frame under Iraqi Seismic Code Loading
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: The engineers have been using a nonlinear static procedure or pushover analysis due to its simplicity. Pushover analysis is a useful technique to assess how a structure performs when subjected to earthquake loads. The plastic deformation is located in a small zone, namely the plastic hinge zone. A significant design parameter is the length of the plastic hinge region, where intense containment should be given to increase the member's ductility for safety from severe events such as earthquakes. This work tries to investigate the effect of plastic hinge length on the performance points for two-dimensional reinforced concrete frames. Plastic hinge length is adopted by considering Park and Paulay besides Priestley hinge length formulations. The results conducted that that base shear capacity does not depend on the plastic hinge length for two equations of plastic hinge length, while the results show that the increase of the displacement capacity of Paulay equation was 87.72% and 10.05% higher than Priestly equation for 4- and 7 stories respectively. The results also show that the two expressions don’t affect the performance level by generating the elastic response spectrum according to the updated Iraqi seismic code-2017.

articleTitle: Experimental Analysis Modelling of Tower Solar Chimney
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: Solar Tower Chimney (STC) is one of the sustainable sources. The experiment aims to study the effect of different air temperatures (ambient temperature) on the airflow inside the chimney as well as on the power generated by (STC) during the summer period and the possibility of installing tower solar Chimney in Basrah region. The experiment results show that the power produced by the chimney will increase per hour when the outside temperature increases. In the present work, different values of the air velocity inside the chimney (height 7.2 m) were measured, the maximum was reached at 2:00 pm (2.9 m/s) afternoon when the ambient temperature was 45.8 C°. The absorbing surface effect is discussed. It was noted that the high level of humidity and the excessively flying dust on most days of the year are considered to be the most important determinants of this type of system. The present study included developing a simplified mathematical model depending on the conservation of energy and mass for the present solar chimney.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Turbulence and Non-Newtonian Blood Rheology Models Through An FDA Nozzle
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: Model of a nozzle from Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is subjected to an extensive computational fluid dynamics (CFD) investigation of turbulent blood flow. To study the effect of non-Newtonian blood flow at expected levels of shear rate and turbulent kinetic energy, a typical model of Newtonian blood flow is compared to the non-Newtonian model. The elliptic blending Reynolds stress model is utilized in this research to represent the impacts of turbulence. In expressions of the average flow field, levels of turbulence, and universal shear rate, the sensibility of variable viscosity models are examined, and Fractional Flow Reserve is employed as an indicator to determine the degree of stenosis using pressure measurements with varying Reynolds numbers. The clinical significance of the findings is discussed, as well as modelling uncertainties, with the observation that turbulent kinetic energy and turbulent viscosity ratio is often projected to be lower in non-Newtonian flow than in Newtonian flow, the authors also noticed that there is no difference before the stenosis area, while the difference occurs after the stenosis and as Reynolds number increases, the value of velocity and strain rate increases.

articleTitle: The Powerful Method for Smart Classroom Communication Rely on IoT
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: A smart classroom is the merger of knowledge used at the teacher's desk and in front of the classroom with students' attendance and a reallocation that allows the effective usage of that knowledge. Currently, data communication skills and the Internet of Things are already global in the area of teaching. Therefore, they started significantly to change the way of teaching and learning. In this paper, a new method for controlling and communicating with the smart classroom was achieved with a level of security and efficiency using the internet of things technology to control all devices of the classroom such as air conditioner, data show, lights, and so on. the nodemcu ESP8266 board was used in this paper which is more suitable for controlling the classroom for the reason of low cost and accurate result and easy to connect to the internet. In This method, the user can control all classroom components from any place in the world. The contribution of this paper is that within the era of coronavirus and with electronic teaching it is essential to deal with everything remotely without touching any switch or plug and this method applies this idea. The discussion shows that the system is effective, low cost, accurate and secure without error.

articleTitle: Employing Iraqi Military Elements In Contemporary Architecture
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: This paper highlights the military fortifications, it is a serious attempt to study an important aspect of the military architecture in Iraq and the motives for its construction related to the political, military and economic conditions of the country. Thus, the research problem emerged, the lack of knowledge about the unique features of Islamic military architecture and how to employ them in contemporary architectural production. Therefore, the research aims to "identify and clarify the characteristics of military architecture and its distinctive characteristics and the process of employing them within the architectural product, and the research methodology included building a framework of knowledge that includes the most important vocabulary in clarifying its details. Architectural features and their role in the engineering of military buildings and then application, and the research assume the presence of features that are unique to military architecture. Islamic and these features are clear in contemporary architecture. The most important finding of the research is military architecture is nothing but an art that does not exhaust its aesthetic, functional and expressive powers, so it requires attention and preservation through studies concerned with its dimensions and expressive values of manifestations of originality, strength and uniqueness.

articleTitle: Biometric Based Wireless Network Security-Status, Challenges and Future Trends
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: Every day, the acceptance of mobile products and cloud computing services grows. The concerns of tested candid user, that is a fundamental flaw in classical decryption, are addressed by symmetric safety expertise Traditional symmetric applications have been fully researched over the past ten years and are on the verge of a significant upgrade in terms of authentication and recognition. Many difficulties, however, remain unanswered, and related study continues. A biometric technique in Wireless network applications is a form of safety technique which identifies an individual based on his / her biometric features.

articleTitle: Massive MIMO: An Overview, Recent Challenges, and Future Research Directions
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: The exponentially growing data traffic in modern communication systems results in the rise of both the shortage of system information rate and extra emissions of carbon. Large-scale multiple-input multiple-output techniques can enhance the energy together with the spectrum performance and have been observed as a talented approach for the next version of wireless communication systems. This paper examines the fundamentals of Massive MIMO technology, its importance, and its prominent role in 5G communication networks. As well, it statements the challenges that are still open to researchers to solving it. We discussed the researchers’ work in using the Massive MIMO technique to improve efficiency and increase throughput, as it was found MIMO systems are effectively applied to spectral efficiency and energy efficiency. Massive MIMO can be combined with current cellular technologies such as the non-orthogonal multiple access strategy to increase the data rates of these communication systems.

articleTitle: Crypto Warfare Techniques- Status, Challenges, and Future Trends
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: With the increasing demand for fast internet and electronic commerce, great concern has emerged in the problems related to the safety and security of information related to computers and communications. Cryptography is the science concerned with studying and confirming the confidentiality, safety, security and privacy of the data that can be provided to the user, as well as the confidentiality and reliability of the data user. In this paper, Numerous encryption algorithms have been studied to describe a state-of-the-art overview of Crypto Warfare techniques status, challenges, and future trends. The study supports the importance of these topics by highlighting the urgent needs of this topic. We present various challenges facing Crypto Warfare Techniques and summarize the status and future trends

articleTitle: Cloud-based Parallel Computing System Via Single-Client Multi-Hash Single-Server Multi-Thread
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: Parallel Distributed Processing is a relatively new method. Distributed cloud connects data and applications delivered by utilizing cloud computing technologies from several geographical locations. When something is distributed in IT, it is transferred among multiple systems located across diverse areas. The expanse of information besides the interval it takes towards analyzing adding to monitoring projected results efficiently and effectively has been dramatically enhanced. This paper presented a system to assist users in doing composite tasks interactively with the least processing time. Distributed-Parallel-Processing (DPP) and CloudComputing (CC) are the two most great technologies, can process and answer the user problem quickly. Developing a suggested system used several sources (source generators, under-test load, computing machines, and processing units) and (webservers) through the cloud. Hash codes are generated on the client-side and sent towards the webserver. The webserver delivers these does to cracking servers that have been specified. It has been verified that while employing light load (single hash-code) with multi-servers and multiprocessors, the suggested system gives improved efficiency (in terms of Kernel-burst, User-bust, and Total-execution) timings. Although it has been demonstrated that employing large loads (many under-testing codes) with many computing machines using multiprocessors improves the system’s performance. The suggested computational system outperforms it in terms of parallel processing. The proposed method took these situations into account due to the code-breaking influences by two precarious criteria (minimal breaking-time besides cost-effective usage of computer resources).

articleTitle: Game Theory Role in Wireless Network Security – Status, Challenges and Future trends
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: As the Internet grows omnipresent in the lives of these people, people rely largely on the Internet for appropriate communication and quick access to information. The network has security problems, though. Network security has become a challenge since numerous new network assaults have gotten increasingly complicated and caused enormous network losses. The Game Theory technique has been introduced as a viable tool for addressing such challenging cyber threats. Methods of game theory were offered as valuable tools for addressing these difficult cyber threats. Many researchers have advocated using game theory to improve network security. On the one hand, the lack of a quantitative decision-making framework is a major drawback of traditional network security systems. Game theory handles the problem of several individuals competing with opposing motivations or goals; it can give a mathematical framework for studying and modeling network-related security challenges.

articleTitle: Voltage Stability Enhancement in Wasit 400 kV Grid by Using STATCOM
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: The operation of Power systems becomes more significant as the demand rises continually. Due to environmental and economic constraints, the fast rise of load demand imposes electrical power systems to work near-critical limits. Electrical power systems' goal is to provide energy with suitable frequency and voltage to the consumers with minimum cost. Therefore, voltage stability has a crucial role in the environment of the power system to meet the load demand. This paper introduces an improvement on voltage stability margin by installing Flexible AC Transmission Systems (FACTS) devices using Static Synchrouns Compensation Device (STATCOM) in the power system under different contingencies such as load increase or decrease, transmission lines outage, and generated power reduction. The prototype of STATCOM was built with a strategy to improve the voltage level in the grid to support the system's requirements during the disturbances. The controller considers the positive and negative sequence components that appear during faults, and the contribution of STATCOM supports the faulted phase upon the viewer. Thus, the active contribution to improving the power system's performance during faults makes static compensation devices contribute to support the system during an event of increased loads or unsymmetrical faults. This paper concentrates on STATCOM performance during unsymmetrical faults in the Iraqi grid as a strong(stiff) grid. The proposed controller took in simulation (using MATLAB /Simulink) the Iraqi national grid at Wasit 400 kV with the thermal Wasit power plant (2100MW) consideration. The simulation findings demonstrate that the positive and negative current controllers in the STATCOM operate better together than they do independently, resulting in an improvement in the voltage level of the system during asymmetric faults.

articleTitle: Social Innovation in Urban Development Projects
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: Recently, there has been interest in different regions of the world in the innovations of activities created by a group of people in a particular urban area, according to the needs of that area and its exploitation in urban development processes, it helps the designer to identify the needs of the place and then determine the uses of the land in proportion to With his needs, and thus the movement and activation of the place and making development useful, and recently due to the economic crisis and the Corona epidemic, the interest was in this aspect in order to support the local product. The aim of the research is to focus on social innovations that can help us and to find out why they cannot develop in our country compared to the world. Then arriving at the research problem, which is the lack of a clear conception of the activities that are considered social innovations and the reason for their being able to reach what the countries of the world have reached. These activities appeared and disappeared according to people’s ability and abilities, and the city of Baghdad was taken as a case study. After calculating the features that apply to the inherited activities that exist in some places, such as the beeps market or temporary activities that spread in certain places, the result of applying vocabulary was that there is some vocabulary they apply to these activities and others do not, which negatively affected the place. Urban development processes, if any, ignore the social innovations that characterize the place. As for temporary activities, the reason for their decline is the lack of a special place to contain them, as well as the empowerment by an authority or organization.

articleTitle: Measuring City’s Social Urban Sustainability Criteria Using GIS: Kut City as a Case Study
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: Sustainability criteria and how to measure them in practice in the city Master Plan are considered the main concern of planners and decision-makers. The paper seeks to study and apply these criteria to a residential area in Wasit Governorate - Iraq. The multiplicity and diversity of criteria adopted for the level of the residential neighbourhood unit produce a sustainable urban environment at the neighbourhood level. The study refers to a different result from the prevailing ideas of the neighbourhoods in society and decision-makers. Hence, the research promotes new concepts of what is supposed to be the neighbourhoods. As well as recommended, the local authorities in Kut city should seek to find appropriate solutions to the apparent deviations in the sustainability criteria of the study area neighbourhoods to improve the environmental reality of that life and achieve satisfaction with the population. The analysis adopted the sustainability indicators reality for the residential neighbourhoods of the study area and the (GIS) software, comparing the validity of the actual situation for each locality with the approved standards and determining the deviation. The results characterized Anwar al-Sadr neighbourhood as the best neighbourhood in response to the criteria of sustainability adopted in the research board.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Design of Intensive Care Spaces to Confront the Corona Virus - the Study Area, Baghdad City
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: Many hospitals face challenges to adapt to the changing environment and persistent diseases and after the emergence of the Corona crisis that caused by an increase in the number of cases of people living with HIV increased the need to accommodate more patients in spaces, which led to the momentum on hospitals to absorb increasing numbers of cases, which led to finding design solutions for the intensive care environment to continuously accommodate people while maintaining the privacy and safety of occupants and staff and increasing the rate of recovery, the goal of this paper is to identify the type of change in care spaces The status associated with the Covid-19 pandemic is the possibility of expanding within Iraqi hospitals and the possibility of providing solutions for its development, The paper has made use of the concept of negative pressurized areas, the flexible module, the entry to the operating department and the connection between the intensive care unit and the staff department with a strong spatial relationship, to increase the possibility of further development.

articleTitle: A 5G Waveforms Detection based-Windowed Cosine-Hamming Filter
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: The kinds of 5G waveforms require to saturate different demands of transmitting signals. Unfortunately, the spectrum resources are limited. Thus, the spectrum sensing technique should be overcome this issue of communications. In this paper, a spectrum sensing technique is proposed for 5G waveforms detection, such as F-OFDM, UFMC, and FBMC. The decision of detection is obtained according to some parameters such as signal length, cyclic prefix, shape, energy, and mapper. The proposed method includes windowed cosine filtering with Hamming. The results are validated with the Monte-Carlo simulation. The proposed sensing technique achieved better detection performance than that of related techniques in terms of detection probability (> 0.95), false alarm probability (< 0.05), signal-to-noise ratio (< 0 dB), and level of complexity.

articleTitle: Larceny Revelations of Electric Energy with Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: Energy-based life-sustaining requirements, such as electrical power, are necessary for daily survival. It is frequently utilized in residential, industrial, agricultural, and medical settings. Without energy, life is quite limited. Technologies are constantly evolving and refined with a broader range of features. As the electricity demand elevated and due to the evolution of simplified bill payment ways, the heist of electric energy is still an issue. Electricity theft detection enables a more efficient and cost-effective transfer method to the consumer, as power theft is a matter for all utilities. The purpose of this article is to suggest a novel way for electricity fraud detection and cost estimate of frauded power with allow monitoring main distribution supply lines details to know future expansion needed. This design used a private cloud utilizing Raspberry Pi at the main feeder and a single central algorithm for detection. In addition, this design will minimize devices used concerning previous systems, give precise results, and make the easy utility monitoring of all-day consumer power fraudulent if it occurs. The suggested system can also detect and identify fraudulent electricity meters and a direct line hook up around the clock. Furthermore, it can calculate the cost of frauded energy.

articleTitle: Patterns of Physical Formation in Architecture (Iraqi Situation as case study)
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: Despite the development of architecture, the physical information remains one of the most important methods to organize the relationships between mass & space, which explains its importance, as the lower the levels of formation, the higher the percentage of slums; that limit the value of the architectural product. Accordingly, the research problem was represented in the following: "Crystallization of a comprehensive theoretical conception of the physical formation in architecture", While the aim of the research was to reveal the interrelationship between the mass and space in the architectural product. The research adopted the descriptive analytical method through building a knowledge framework, then atheoretical framework extracted from previous literature to be embodied in its final form in four main vocabulary, namely: sources of physical formation, patterns of physical formation, physical formation energy, and the rules for the physical formation. it has been applied to the Iraqi projects to show the extent to which these indicators have been achieved and come to conclusions, that showed the tendency of architects to repeat the physical structures according to the Sierpinski triangle pattern more than crystalline patterns. Also, projective formation is the dominant pattern compared to topological and parametric patterns.

articleTitle: A Preliminary Study of Using Geothermal-Piles in Baghdad City
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: Using sustainable energy technologies are essential to overcome the challenges that power sources based on fossil fuel derivatives faces in the current time. Geothermal-pile structure is one of these technologies that sustain energy and a preferable economic option for several countries. The heat exchange between such systems and surrounding soil is considered a key factor in accounting for the total thermal behaviour of buildings and the accumulating stresses in structural members and adjacent soil. Because of the lack of knowledge of using energy-piles in Iraq, specifically in Baghdad city, this paper presents a preliminary study of recent research works and developments related to energy-pile systems. Based on former laboratory, field, numerical studies, and case studies, common aspects of energy-piles performance and their influence on the adjacent ground are introduced. The current knowledge allows us to identify and address further potential research opportunities related to the application of geothermal-pile systems in Baghdad city.

articleTitle: Integrated Project Management Strategies-Residential Investment Case Study
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advance of Sustainable Engineering and its Application (ICASEA)
abstract: After the arrival of the initiative of the Central Bank of Iraq in 2020 to grant citizens and investors housing loans, it is expected that residential investment projects will multiply. Project management is an essential element for the success of projects, and the architect must be familiar with it to achieve realistic designs and given the lack of studies that dealt with the concepts of integrated project management and residential investment together. The study aimed to present a clear vision of integrated project management strategies, hence the problem of the study in the lack of comprehensiveness of previous studies on integrated project management strategies in Iraqi residential investment projects. Accordingly, the research hypothesis emerged as the project management strategy (selection of the site, project phases) are integrated for the success of residential investment projects. To verify the hypothesis, a theoretical framework was built and used in two projects Bismaya and Iraq Gate and a field survey as a measurement method was used, as well as descriptive analysis. The study found that the two projects succeeded in the strategies by a rate of 74% for the Gateway project and 66% for the Bismaya project, with the latter’s failure to choose the site with a rate of 51% and its superiority in the project stages by 80%.

Author Keywords: and residential investment project phases strategy
